title: Bashar :: 2027 The Year Everything Changes - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: Bashar opens by announcing that 2027 marks the year of imminent open contact with extraterrestrial civilizations. Official introduction to Earth society will occur within two years, initially featuring hybrids, Pleiadeans, and other beings. The session addresses why the formula doesn't guarantee starving artists achieve success, explaining that not all self-identified artists act on genuine passion, and life paths include varied lessons. Bashar emphasizes understanding the deeper mechanics of the manifestation formula and distinguishing between ego-driven wants and soul-aligned needs.

qa_topics.question: Why does the formula work perfectly but starving artists still struggle?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Not all artists truly act on their passions; life paths include varied lessons and challenges. Different people choose different life plans for different reasons, and expressions of artistic desire don't guarantee positive manifestation without aligned soul intentions.

qa_topics.question: If life gives us what we need instead of what we want, shouldn't we stop trying to manifest?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Understanding the formula reveals that challenges benefit you in positive states and curiosity. Learning the distinction between negative ego assumptions and soul-aligned needs ensures fulfillment; neutrality and openness activate the formula's benefits.

quotes.quote: 2027, the year everything changes. Open contact is imminent within two years.
Not all artists act on their passions. Different people choose different life paths.
What you need will fulfill you although sometimes what you want won't.
Learn the difference between negative ego assumptions and soul knowledge.
quotes.context: Distinguishing true needs from ego desires

quotes.quote: Stay in neutrality, curiosity and openness, you will get what you need.
